steps.title: Create a test API key
say: Sign in, then go to Developers, API keys, and click Create key.
Copy the key, open .env in the project root, and add a line: PAYMENTS_KEY= followed by the key.

steps.title: Download the webhook config
say: On the Webhooks page, click Add endpoint, then Download config.
Save the file as config/webhook.json in the project root.
